observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && echo "=== OpenRouter: model uncensored gratis ==="; curl -s --max-time 40 "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models" -o /tmp/or.json -w "[%{http_code}] "; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/or.json'))['data']
un=[m for m in d if any(k in m['id'].lower() for k in ['uncens','ablit','dolphin','hermes','venice','unfilter','nsfw'])]
free=[m for m in un if m.get('pricing',{}).get('prompt') in ('0','0.0')]
print('total model:',len(d),'| uncensored:',len(un),'| uncensored+GRATIS:',len(free))
for m in free[:25]: print('  FREE',m['id'])
" 2>&1 | head -30
